clue.text: See 7
Come out with foolish people and cycle

definitions.note: phrase meaning to take industrial action

parts.note: goons are idiots, foolish people
a trike is a tricycle, a kind of cycle

explanation.surface: An invitation to emerge and go riding with some silly companions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Come out' is the British idiom for workers walking off the job together.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers who come out are taking industrial action by stopping work together.

clue.text: Diocese in predicament about right psalm for Ash Wednesday

indicators.note: the diocese word sits inside the predicament word

parts.note: to be in the mire is to be in a predicament

indicators.note: the diocese word wraps around the letter for right

parts.note: a see is a bishop's diocese

explanation.surface: A diocese facing trouble chooses a penitential psalm for the start of Lent.
explanation.walkthrough: SEE for diocese is a crossword staple; 'in' and 'about' each name one wrapping, nested here.
explanation.definitionFit: The Miserere, Psalm 51, is the penitential psalm traditionally sung on Ash Wednesday.

clue.text: Game to get you knocked about on leg joint

parts.note: the hock is the joint in an animal's hind leg

indicators.note: knocked about signals the old word for you being turned round

parts.note: ye is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: A sport in which you might get a whack on the leg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked about' turns YE round; 'on' places it after the leg joint, as across answers read left to right.
explanation.definitionFit: Hockey is a team sport played with sticks and a ball or puck.

clue.text: Property of some unstable materials, possibly lithium or iron

definitions.meaning: the time taken for half a radioactive sample to decay
the symbols Li and Fe are each one half of the four-letter word for existence

explanation.surface: A characteristic of unstable substances, perhaps lithium or iron.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is cryptic: Li (lithium) or Fe (iron) is half of LIFE.
explanation.definitionFit: Radioactive isotopes are characterised by the time it takes half their atoms to decay.

clue.text: Tubes unclean, ale initially disgusting!

indicators.note: disgusting suggests the letters are messed up and rearranged
initially means take the first letter of ale

explanation.surface: An outraged complaint about dirty tubes and revolting beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disgusting' scrambles UNCLEAN plus A, the first letter of 'ale' signalled by 'initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannulae are thin medical tubes inserted into the body; the word is the Latin plural.

clue.text: Bully to behave at home when curbed by partner

parts.note: to do is to behave or act, as in do well

indicators.note: curbed by means held in by the partner word

parts.note: a mate is a partner
in means at home

explanation.surface: Advice to act nicely at home when your spouse keeps you in check.
explanation.definitionFit: To bully someone is to dominate them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Poet given old coins, money prize not the highest

parts.note: annas were coins of former Indian currency

indicators.note: the top letter of the down entry is dropped

parts.note: a reward is a prize of money

explanation.surface: A poet receives antique coins and a cash award that isn't the top one.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the 'highest' letter is the first, so 'not the highest' removes R from REWARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Anna Seward was an eighteenth-century English poet, the Swan of Lichfield.

clue.text: Food place at table? The first shall be last

indicators.note: the biblical phrase tells us to move the opening letter to the end

parts.note: a seat is a place at table

explanation.surface: A biblical saying about who gets fed first at a dinner table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The first shall be last' moves the S of SEAT to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Eats is informal slang for food.

clue.text: Religious symbol policy mostly followed by school

indicators.note: mostly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a line is a policy, as in the party line
a gam is a school of whales

explanation.surface: A religious emblem adopted as policy by a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims LINE to LIN; GAM is a crossword favourite for a school of whales.
explanation.definitionFit: The lingam is the phallic emblem of Shiva in Hindu worship.

clue.text: Lock up an alien, offering means of communication

parts.note: to intern is to imprison or lock up
ET is the film's extraterrestrial

explanation.surface: Detaining an extraterrestrial lets it phone home.
explanation.definitionFit: The internet is a global network used for communication.

clue.text: Commercial establishment below that has drug put into coffee

indicators.note: put into signals the other pieces going inside the coffee

parts.note: a latte is milky coffee
under means below
E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: Something unsavoury about a business where the coffee is spiked downstairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put into' sends both pieces inside the coffee together; E is slang for the drug ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: A launderette is a self-service laundry, a business premises.

clue.text: Agent led Tory astray, from what we hear

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent

indicators.note: astray suggests the letters wandering out of order

explanation.surface: Rumour has it a salesman misled a Conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: Reportedly means according to what people say, as heard from others.

clue.text: US state with mountains allows people who wander about

parts.note: VA is Virginia, home of the Blue Ridge Mountains
grants means allows

explanation.surface: A mountainous American state lets drifters roam.
explanation.definitionFit: Vagrants are homeless people who roam from place to place.

clue.text: Fellow with intellect can describe chemical compound

definitions.note: the answer is an adjective applied to compounds

parts.note: Stan is a man's name, any fellow
nous is common sense or intellect

explanation.surface: A clever chap is able to explain a chemical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can describe' makes the definition adjectival; 'can' is not the tin it hints at.
explanation.definitionFit: Stannous is the adjective for tin compounds in the lower valency, like stannous fluoride.

clue.text: There's something disappointing about a dry haircut

indicators.note: about means the disappointment word wraps the others

parts.note: a flop is a failure
TT, teetotal, means dry

explanation.surface: Complaint about a dull, lifeless hairstyle.
explanation.walkthrough: TT (teetotal) is a convention for 'dry', i.e. not drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-top is a crew cut trimmed level across the crown.

clue.text: Recorders? Composer may admit hesitation

indicators.note: admit means take in, so the hesitation goes inside

parts.note: Thomas Tallis was a Tudor composer
er is a hesitation sound

explanation.surface: Musical instruments, and a composer pausing to let them in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recorders' with its question mark is not the instrument but people who keep tallies.
explanation.definitionFit: Talliers keep tallies, recording counts or scores.

clue.text: Favoured no longer, performance that's crude

parts.note: in means in favour, popular
ex means former
an act is a performance

explanation.surface: A once-popular act now judged rough.
explanation.definitionFit: Crude in the sense of rough or approximate means imprecise.

clue.text: One rare child playing with rag doll, which may lead to big scientific discovery

definitions.text: which may lead to big scientific discovery

indicators.note: playing with suggests the letters being toyed with and rearranged

explanation.surface: An unusual child amusing itself with a floppy doll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing with' stands between the two lots of fodder, ONE RARE CHILD and RAG DOLL.
explanation.definitionFit: The particle accelerator at CERN found the Higgs boson, a major scientific breakthrough.

clue.text: Where in France an old man's penned sheep

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so the French word sits inside

parts.note: an gives A
dad is one's old man
ou is French for where

explanation.surface: A French farmer's father has fenced in a sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old man's' reads as 'old man has', and 'penned' says the French word sits inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The aoudad is the Barbary sheep of North Africa.

clue.text: Spots a thing in the road — circular thing to be avoided

indicators.note: avoided means left out of the road object

parts.note: a traffic cone sits in the road
O looks like a circle

explanation.surface: Advice to a driver about a hazard in the road and a ring to steer round.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin condition producing spots.

clue.text: Several parties offering endless jam

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a block is a jam or blockage

explanation.surface: Many political parties offering a never-ending traffic jam.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is an alliance of parties or nations acting together.

clue.text: See 18
Way to get occupational therapy's address

parts.note: a turn is a way or direction taken, as in a turn in the road

indicators.note: the clue reads cryptically as turn the next letters round to get the therapy abbreviation

parts.note: OT is the usual abbreviation for occupational therapy

explanation.surface: Directions to the therapy clinic.
explanation.walkthrough: Pasquale's joke: the whole answer, taken as an order, describes exactly how the therapy letters are produced, so the wordplay and definition overlap playfully.
explanation.definitionFit: To address a task is to set about it, to apply oneself.

clue.text: Salad and cheese, half portion, girl's tucked into

indicators.note: tucked into means placed inside the other piece
half portion means the back half of the word cheese

parts.note: Carol is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl eating a salad with some cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half portion' takes the back half of the word 'cheese' itself, not a synonym; 'tucked into' puts the girl inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Escarole is a broad-leaved endive used as salad.

clue.text: Location of famous saint's bones

definitions.meaning: the city in Asia Minor where Saint Paul was born

explanation.surface: Where a celebrated saint's remains lie.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul the Apostle came from Tarsus, and the tarsus is the set of ankle bones.
